name: RAG & Knowledge-System Evaluation
description: Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge systems by separating corpus, retrieval, grounding, generation, freshness, permission, and end-to-end failure modes.

tasks.name: Define knowledge task contract
tasks.objective: Define users, questions/actions, corpus boundaries, freshness SLA, permissions, citation requirements, abstention behavior, latency/cost targets, and unacceptable failure classes.

tasks.name: Audit corpus
tasks.objective: Measure source authority, duplication, staleness, contradictory versions, chunkability, metadata quality, access controls, coverage, and provenance.

tasks.name: Evaluate retrieval
tasks.objective: Build representative and hard query sets with relevance judgments; measure recall/precision/ranking, multi-hop retrieval, metadata filtering, stale-result behavior, and permission leakage independently of generation.

tasks.name: Evaluate grounding and generation
tasks.objective: Measure answer correctness, faithfulness to retrieved evidence, citation support, completeness, abstention, conflict handling, and resistance to malicious or irrelevant retrieved content.

tasks.name: Evaluate end-to-end tasks
tasks.objective: Test realistic user workflows including follow-ups, ambiguous questions, long context, access changes, corpus updates, outages, latency, and cost. Attribute failures to corpus, retrieval, orchestration, or generation rather than one aggregate score.

tasks.name: Create regression and monitoring suite
tasks.objective: Freeze high-value cases, failure exemplars, data freshness checks, permission tests, quality thresholds, drift monitors, and re-evaluation triggers for corpus/model/retriever changes.

tasks.name: Publish decomposed scorecard
tasks.objective: Report component and end-to-end metrics, uncertainty, failure taxonomy, cost/latency, representative traces, known gaps, and prioritized fixes without hiding weak retrieval behind fluent generation.
